# libabigail suppression rules for the "ABI compatibility" CI check
# (see .github/workflows/abi-check.yml).
#
# SbHash<Key, Type> (src/misc/SbHash.h) is explicitly documented as
# "internal and must not be exposed in the Coin API": it is a private
# implementation detail, never declared in a public header, and no
# external Coin consumer can legitimately depend on any of its
# instantiated methods' symbols. Changes to its internals (e.g. which
# methods get instantiated for a given Key/Type pair) routinely add or
# remove symbols as an incidental side effect of unrelated internal
# improvements -- that is not a real ABI break, so it is suppressed
# here rather than forcing every such PR to explain away a false
# positive.

[suppress_type]
  type_kind = class
  name_regexp = ^SbHash<
  label = SbHash is a private internal container (src/misc/SbHash.h: "must not be exposed in the Coin API"); its instantiated methods are implementation detail, not part of the public ABI.

[suppress_function]
  name_regexp = ^SbHash<
  label = SbHash is a private internal container (src/misc/SbHash.h: "must not be exposed in the Coin API"); its instantiated methods are implementation detail, not part of the public ABI.

# Lazy SbHash storage means SoGLDriverDatabaseP::SoGLDriver no longer needs an
# out-of-line default constructor. SoGLDriver is defined only in the private
# implementation file src/rendering/SoGLDriverDatabase.cpp; these constructor
# symbols therefore cannot be used by Coin clients. Match the exact Itanium ABI
# symbols rather than suppressing the enclosing implementation class broadly.

[suppress_function]
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN19SoGLDriverDatabaseP10SoGLDriverC[12]Ev$
  label = SoGLDriverDatabaseP::SoGLDriver is a source-file-private implementation type; its compiler-emitted constructors are not part of Coin's public ABI.
